# Contributing

Great that you want to contribute to the EthereumJS ecosystem. EthereumJS is community-maintained; everyone is welcome (see our [Code of Conduct](./CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md)).

**Start here:**

- [DEVELOPER.md](../DEVELOPER.md) — clone, everyday commands, conventions, tooling, CI overview
- [ARCHITECTURE.md](../ARCHITECTURE.md) — how packages fit together
- [CONTRIBUTING workflow](https://github.com/ethereumjs/ethereumjs-monorepo/blob/master/DEVELOPER.md#get-running) — open a PR against `master` unless backporting

Happy coding!
